name: Gated Expansions Characterize Quasi-Median Graphs
statement: A finite graph is a partial Hamming graph exactly when it is obtainable from $K_1$ by $k$-ary expansions. It is quasi-median exactly when it is obtainable from $K_1$ by gated expansions. The binary bipartite specialization is the median expansion theorem, but general gated expansions permit $k>2$ and cliques.
comments: Partial Hamming and quasi-median graphs are retained here as the precise ambient scope of the operation theorem; they are not promoted to nodes in the partial-cube class hierarchy.
